request:
镜头 s13：纪录片中引用的旧资料影像，时长 10 秒，16:9 横屏，24fps，单镜头一镜到底（只写 [Shot 1]）。
年代与画面风格（detailed_description 第一行照此英文书写）：observational documentary footage from a research institute's own 2050s film archive, shot on Super 16 colour negative: lively visible grain, slightly soft resolution, cold fluorescent light mixed with one warm desk lamp, muted desaturated palette, deep shadows, imperfect handheld framing
该类型的纪录片默认机位：archival footage quoted inside a documentary
导演意图（自然语言）：资料影像，手持，镜头慢慢推向站起来的宋工。他站起来，看着桌首的人，问了一句。会议室安静了一秒，有人轻轻笑出声。环境声：椅子挪动声、几声低笑。
情绪：tense, lonely, defiant
建议的景别与运镜（只做一个主要运镜）：medium shot, handheld archival camera with one slow push in toward Song
景深与虚实：Foreground shoulders out of focus, Song sharp, the red lens behind him a soft glowing disc.
输入图片（按发送顺序；Subject N 对应 Picture N）：
Picture 1: the storyboard keyframe of this shot (opening frame). It shows: Archival institute footage, medium shot: Song stands up at the end of the long conference table, his round glasses catching the fluorescent light, facing the room; behind him the black terminal with its red lens. Blocking lock: Song stands at frame centre at the end of the table, seen past the blurred shoulders of seated members in the foreground left and right; the red lens glows on the wall behind him at frame right.
Picture 2: Engineer Song (Song Qi, 33 in 2048, systems engineer on the 550 quantum-computer project) (character reference; role: the protagonist). A 33-year-old Chinese man, systems engineer on a national quantum-computer project. Slim, medium height, short neat black hair with a side parting, clean-shaven, a small mole under his right eye, warm attentive eyes with faint laugh lines, thin round steel-rimmed glasses. Light-grey knitted cardigan over a pale blue collared work shirt, a blank white ID card on a dark lanyard, a cheap black digital wristwatch on his left wrist.
台词（逐字照抄，按顺序，每句放进一个 <d>[Chinese] ...</d>）：
1. Song (a man in his early thirties, warm and gentle voice with a smile in it) — 宋工（三十出头男性的声音，温和、带笑意）: 要是这个大脑，有一天有了自己的想法呢？
现场环境声：a chair scraping, silence, then a few low chuckles, air conditioning hum
画面中没有字幕、文字、数字和水印；没有任何音乐和旁白；只说普通话。
